answer: Each fake identity must graft one kernel onto its own reef shelf, carried there by a raven. The k-th shelf costs k^k spores: 1, 4, 27, 256, 3125. Ten fakes cost 10,405,071,317 spores and a hundred cost over 10^200, since each new shelf sits further out. Two kernels grafted to one shelf rot together at the close, so clones cannot share a shelf's toll.
